notes.title: Eternal Threads Demo - NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
⏰ WE BRING EXCITING NEWS PROSPECTIVE OPERATORS ⏰
We’re pleased to announce that the Eternal Threads demo has returned to the Steam store!

If you’ve got the game on your wish list, but haven’t yet pressed the purchase button, or you’ve just discovered the game, download the demo and experience what this story-driven time-manipulating puzzler has to offer.

Time really is of the essence as the demo will end when one of the following criteria has been met (whichever is first):
[list]
[*] Played the demo for 60 minutes.
[*] When 25 events have been watched.
[*] When 2 independent decision changes results in lives being saved.
[/list]
[i]Please note: if you played the demo previously, you will not be able to play the demo again.[/i]

Operator, what are you waiting for? Travel back in time and change the past to fix the future.

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1046790/Eternal_Threads/]Download the demo from the Steam Store[/url][/h2]
